meta.name: level-up
meta.description: Use weekly to find and ship one new automation. Walks the 3Ms interview — Mindset (find the candidate) → Method (scope one) → Machine (build it). Trigger on "let's level up", "what should I automate next", "find me leverage this week", or as a Friday ritual. One run = one shipped artifact.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 每周发现并交付一个自动化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每周都想找到并实现一个自动化机会
copy.tagline_en: Find and ship one new automation each week
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to identify and build one automation every week

howto.what: 每周引导你完成一次3Ms访谈，找到并交付一个自动化任务。每次运行产出1个决策记录和1个可交付的自动化产物（提示词、技能或智能体文件）。
howto.when: 首次运行需在连接至少1个MCP/脚本并运行过/audit之后（约第14天）。之后建议每周五下午运行，也可随时按需触发。

say.text: 我们来升级一下，这周有什么可以自动化的？
say.note: 触发3Ms访谈，开始寻找自动化候选任务。

say.text: 我下周应该自动化什么？
say.note: 同样触发访谈，但侧重下周计划。

say.text: 这周有什么能帮我省力的？
say.note: 触发访谈，寻找能提升效率的自动化机会。

howto.what_en: Guides you through a weekly 3Ms interview to find and ship one automation. Each run produces one decision log entry and one deliverable artifact (prompt, skill, or agent file).
howto.when_en: First run requires at least 1 MCP/script connected and /audit run once (around day 14). Recommended weekly on Friday afternoon, but can be triggered on-demand anytime.

say_en.text: Let's level up, what can I automate this week?
say_en.note: Triggers the 3Ms interview to find automation candidates.

say_en.text: What should I automate next week?
say_en.note: Triggers the interview focusing on next week's tasks.
Triggers the interview to find efficiency gains.
